dogecoin.text:
The DOGE website, led by Elon Musk's Department of Government Efficiency, is live, featuring Dogecoin as its avatar.
https://t.co/Cq9oj1BVHM https://t.co/qwrmKZv8kh

The U.S. Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) updated its website logo, replacing the Dogecoin image with a new illustration.
https://t.co/Pya260J0Hh https://t.co/qDV1fQcely

Dogecoin miner Z Squared will go public via a merger with biopharma firm Coeptis (COEP), expected to close in Q3 2025. The new entity will run 9,000 DOGE mining machines, becoming one of the largest publicly traded Dogecoin mining companies.
https://t.co/PvVDRzrv6P https://t.co/UPylPg3GPI

Nasdaq filed with the SEC to list the 21Shares Dogecoin ETF, sponsored by 21Shares US LLC under Rule 5711(d), aiming to track Dogecoin’s performance and expand access to crypto-based investment products.
https://t.co/g92lDvaSWW https://t.co/BJCxWFVNF0

Coinbase and Marden-Kane will pay $2.25m to settle a lawsuit over a 2021 Dogecoin sweepstakes that allegedly misled users, with U.S. traders who bought $100+ in DOGE reimbursed for first-trade fees; Coinbase earned $1.3m from the promo.
https://t.co/3EhFwSvHa7
